messages:
sam: Heads-up — need to align on a joint push for the marketplace + HW partner announcement next quarter. Thinking a coordinated tech preview (gateways + LangChain adapters) + SI enablement docs. Who's available to scope?

mia: I can own partner comms + announcement calendar. Need input on the integration matrix and which ISVs we prioritize.

alex: From eng side we have two blockers: official LangChain adapter needs a tiny API change (bool use_kv_cache) and gateway auth flow needs token-exchange docs. Can prototype the adapter in 2 weeks.

harris: SE notes — most SIs ask for an end-to-end sample deploy (VPC + dedicated) and an orchestration playbook. We should bundle a starter terraform + Helm chart.

jenna: Marketing: recommend a staged announcement — private partner preview -> joint blog + demo -> marketplace listing. Need a single PRD with assets + comms timeline.

sam: Proposed priorities: 1) LangChain & LlamaIndex adapters, 2) gateway auth and onboarding docs, 3) SI deployment blueprint, 4) joint marketing assets. Thoughts? :thought_balloon: 

alex: +1. Quick API diff below — tiny default change to generator call:

```json
{"model": "r-instruct-1", "prompt": "...", "use_kv_cache": true}
```

alex: We'll add a compatibility shim in runtime so older clients don't break. Plan to open PR against adapters repo on Mon.

mia: @jenna can you schedule a two-week sync with partners and SIs? I'll pull together the integration matrix (who supports LangChain, who needs custom gateway).

jenna: Scheduling — propose Wed 10am PT. I'll send invites and add a pre-read. Can someone draft the pre-read bullets?

harris: I'll do a quick SE pre-read: list of deployment recipes, expected perf targets, and common gotchas (KV cache warmup, batching config).

integrations-bot: Reminder: new marketplace guidelines v2 published — see https://intranet.redwood.ai/marketplace-guidelines. Link pinned.

sam: Great. Action items: alex -> PR for adapter API (due +14 days), harris -> SE pre-read (+3 days), mia -> integration matrix (+5 days), jenna -> meeting + invites (by EOD). We'll use this thread for updates. :thumbsup:

mia: One ask — can we surface HW partner compatibility in the pre-read? e.g., recommended GPU instances per model family. I'll coordinate with hw-alliances for spec sheet.

alex: Yes, I'll include perf numbers (tokens/sec) for small/medium/large models on A100, H100, and select cloud VMs.

sam: Perfect. If anyone runs into blockers ping me directly. We'll aim to have a partner preview before EOY.

jenna: Added meeting and agenda. Pre-read draft due Tue EOD.

harris: Noted. Will include quick deploy script snippet in pre-read:

```bash
# deploy demo stack
terraform apply -var='region=us-west-2'
kubectl apply -f helm/redwood-demo-values.yaml
```

sam: Nice. Closing loop — thanks everyone.
